headline: 12.1% of the analysed area changed; dominant change: Land-use change.
narrative: Urban expansion: 8.2 ha, 1.2% of the area (mean confidence 100%). NDBI changed +0.31 and NDVI -0.53 on average: vegetation or farmland was replaced by built-up surfaces.
Deforestation: 13.7 ha, 2.1% of the area (mean confidence 99%). NDVI fell -0.66 and NBR -0.75: dense vegetation was cleared to bare or low cover.
Flooding: 28.1 ha, 4.3% of the area (mean confidence 100%). NDWI rose +1.16 (NDVI -0.96): land that was dry is now covered by open water.
Land-use change: 29.3 ha, 4.5% of the area (mean confidence 100%). NDVI shifted -0.31 without built-up or water signatures: a change of cover such as cropping, regrowth or conversion to bare soil.
